feed.title: MIC Lab
feed.subtitle: The MIC Lab at San Francisco State University makes AI efficient, adaptive, deployable and trustworthy on resource-constrained devices, and applies it to neural-machine interfaces and engineering education.

entry.title: Continued collaboration with Sony SSUP
